title: Lambda Persistence Backdoor
description: The attacker establishes persistent access by deploying a backdoor Lambda function with a privileged execution role. The Lambda code is designed to execute on every invocation (e.g., creating backdoor users or exfiltrating data). The attacker then configures EventBridge rules or S3 event notifications to trigger the Lambda automatically on a schedule or when specific events occur. Finally, the attacker disables or modifies CloudTrail to reduce the likelihood of detection. This creates a self-sustaining backdoor that continues to run even after the initial compromise is remediated.

steps.context: Pass a privileged role to the backdoor Lambda function
Deploy malicious code that executes on every trigger
Configure CloudWatch Events or S3 triggers for automatic execution
Disable CloudTrail logging to evade detection
